description: Create or update a business outbound webhook (URL + subscribed events). Returns a webhook secret on first creation only. Mirrors POST /api/v1/webhooks.

body_format.description: json (default) or form (application/x-www-form-urlencoded, nested keys flattened with dots).

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

custom_headers.description: Extra headers the CRM needs, as { "Header-Name": "value" } (max 20). A null value keeps the saved value for that name. Content-Type, Host, Content-Length and X-KaiCalls-* cannot be set. Values are never returned.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to (get_webhook lists the supported types).

id.description: Existing webhook ID to update (omit to create new).

payload_template.description: Shape the body for a CRM: { "fields": { "<their field>": "<path>" | { "value": <fixed> } } }. A path reads the standard event body (e.g. "data.phone", "occurred_at"); "a|b" takes the first with a value; a dot in the field name nests it ("contact.phone"). Missing paths send null. null restores the standard body.

preset.description: Start the body from a CRM field map. Presets are editable starting points, not exact vendor formats. Ignored when payload_template is also sent.

webhook_url.description: HTTPS/HTTP destination URL for event delivery.

name: set_webhook
title: Set Webhook
